The paper was overall very good and easy to attempt. All MCQs were taken from the handouts, so students who studied the handouts carefully could solve them easily. If you understand the concepts of sentence types, unity, coherence, paragraph writing skills, and the tenses given at the end of the handouts, the paper becomes much easier to solve. Most questions were concept-based, so a clear understanding of these topics is very important. Students should also study conditional types, as a few questions were asked from this topic. In addition, having a strong command over the correct form of verbs is very helpful for solving grammar questions correctly. In short, if you prepare the handouts thoroughly and clear your concepts about grammar and paragraph writing, you can solve the ENG101 paper very comfortably and achieve good marks.
